name: poly_real_nonneg_eq_sum_two_squares
statement: (p : Polynomial ℝ) (h : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval x p) : ∃ f g : Polynomial ℝ, p = f ^ 2 + g ^ 2
closed: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ) (h : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval x p), ∃ f g : Polynomial ℝ, p = f ^ 2 + g ^ 2
informal: A real polynomial that is nonnegative on ℝ is a sum of two squares of real polynomials — strong induction on degree: real roots have even multiplicity (factor out (X-r)^2), irreducible quadratic factors are (X-u)^2 + v^2, and sums of two squares are closed under multiplication (Brahmagupta identity).
type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ), (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval x p) → ∃ f g, p = f ^ 2 + g ^ 2
